fields.Name: SourcedFrom
fields.Description: Connects a synthesized or curated GraphConcept to a supporting ContentItemChunk or document.

fields.Name: Mentions
fields.Description: Connects a ContentItemChunk or document to a GraphConcept or entity record mentioned within its text.

fields.Name: Broader Than
fields.Description: Connects a parent or umbrella concept to a more specific child concept.

fields.Name: NarrowerThan
fields.Description: Connects a specific concept to its broader parent concept.

fields.Name: Defines
fields.Description: Connects a canonical Term or Policy concept to the Entity, Alternate Base View, or Concept it formally defines.

fields.Name: Describes
fields.Description: Connects a Domain or Policy concept to the Entity or resource it describes.

fields.Name: Measures
fields.Description: Connects a Metric concept to the Golden Query, Entity, or Alternate Base View that computes it.

fields.Name: Implements
fields.Description: Connects a Process concept to the Action, AI Agent, or Workflow that implements it.

fields.Name: Governs
fields.Description: Connects a Policy or Steward Role concept to the Process, Domain, or Entity it governs.

fields.Name: DependsOn
fields.Description: Connects a concept, metric, or workflow to another concept it depends upon.

fields.Name: Contradicts
fields.Description: Flags a discrepancy or conflicting numeric/policy threshold between two chunks or concepts for steward review.

fields.Name: Supersedes
fields.Description: Indicates that a newer or higher-authority concept or policy supersedes an older one.

fields.Name: RelatedTo
fields.Description: General symmetric association between two concepts or records.
